title: pm(check-owed-reviews): a same-account review seat the maintainer seated under area-lease mode is still printed `barred`
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by work in flight: nit N1 of the at-tier contract review 6896387034 on PR #33943, card #33845, outside that diff).

## What is wrong

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md` (L13 on `main`) lets a review seat on the PR's own account review it when the maintainer's own word seats it in that review thread, and since PR #33943 `lanes/review.md` L19 points at that exception. `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` does not read the exception: `reviewSeatsOf` (L258–L268 on `main`) bars every review seat whose account is the PR's own (`isBarred`), and its comment cites `lanes/review.md` 独立性 as unconditional. A seat the maintainer seated that way is printed `barred`, so the owed-review report tells the seat no independent reviewer is available when one is.

It errs toward over-barring (no review is waved through); the cost is a seat that waits or re-routes a review it already has.

## Done when

- `check-owed-reviews.mjs` either reads the area-lease exception (the maintainer's word in the review thread, as area-lease.md L13 states it) or says in its output that a same-account seat may be seated by the maintainer under area-lease mode, with a self-test pin either way.
- The `isBarred` comment names the exception instead of calling the bar unconditional.

## Scope

`scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` and its self-test only. `skip-changeset`. Not governed by itself (`scripts/pm/**` outside the register rows); confirm with `check-governed-merges --test` at dispatch.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open check-owed-reviews` → no card on this.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
